title: Security Compliance CSV Schema
description: Maps _SecurityCompliance.csv to CComplianceCsv C# class. Columns 2-5 are optional: older CSVs (and the golden baseline) carry only Best Practice and Status. RuleId is the last column, the SDK rule Id GUID (blank when the SDK object has no Id); it is read only by CI triage (.github/scripts/ScaTriage.psm1) and is not rendered in the report or JSON export.

columns.description: Compliance status (display strings from Get-VhcSecurityCompliance.ps1 StatusObj)
True when the rule type has a label in VbrConfig.json SecurityComplianceRuleNames
Where the displayed label came from
SDK rule Id GUID (equals the REST securityAnalyzer best-practice id); blank when the SDK object has no Id. Always the last column. CI-only, never rendered.
